notes.title: Update Three
notes.content:
BEHOLD:

-Certain buildings will no longer steal your resources when constructed
-Reduced machine spirit infestations in all areas
-Gaining all relic knowledge will no longer result in a snowcrash
-The Faithful will seek shelter more quickly and more often

notes.title: Launch Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Thank you all for submitting feedback. This is the first round of fixed as reported by the community. Other fixes are pending more testing.

1.1 Patch Notes:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would not fully exit when closing the app
[*] Fixed an issue where steam achievements were not being awarded
[*] Fixed an issue where the '+' and '-' signs for production were reversed
[*] Fixed an issue where the Oversoul could become invincible if it took too much damage at one time
[*] Added death effect to the Oversoul to make it clear it has taken too much damage
[/list]

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where the game would not fully exit when closing the app
Fixed an issue where steam achievements were not being awarded
Fixed an issue where the '+' and '-' signs for production were reversed
Fixed an issue where the Oversoul could become invincible if it took too much damage at one time

tags.feature: Added death effect to the Oversoul to make it clear it has taken too much damage

notes.title: Beta Patch 1
notes.content:
Hi all, thanks to everyone who is a beta participant, truly surprised by the number of you. I had expected maybe a few dozen but there are hundreds! 

Steam Cloud is included in this update but it is disabled until full release. Please let me know if there are any issues caused by this even in its dormant state.

Patch Notes:

-Fixed an issue with Shrines where they would block future construction
-Fixed various small visual issues
-Added Steam Cloud save support
-Added Steam Achievements in preparation for release (you can't unlock them yet :) )

tags.bug: -Fixed an issue with Shrines where they would block future construction

tags.feature: -Added Steam Achievements in preparation for release (you can't unlock them yet :) )
